description: This file defines an internal interface 'ILocalGrainDirectory' within the Orleans runtime project, specifying methods for managing local grain directory operations such as starting/stopping the service, lookup, cache management, and exposure of internal directory data.

methods.name: UnregisterAfterNonexistingActivation
methods.description: Removes a record for a non-existing activation, used for cleanup with race considerations.

methods.name: LocalLookup
methods.description: Fetches local directory information for a grain, indicating whether data is complete.

methods.name: InvalidateCacheEntry
methods.description: Invalidates cache for a specific activation or grain.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateCacheEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates cache data for a grain at a specific silo.

methods.name: GetPrimaryForGrain
methods.description: Returns the silo that is the primary owner for a grain in testing scenarios.

methods.name: GetLocalDirectoryData
methods.description: Gets directory info for a grain from local directory partition.

methods.name: GetLocalCacheData
methods.description: Gets directory info from local cache for a grain.

methods.name: TryCachedLookup
methods.description: Attempts to find a grain in the local cache.

methods.name: IsSiloInCluster
methods.description: Checks if a given silo address is part of the cluster.
